column1: Tab 1 — Capacity Matrix: Energy × Mood (16 states)

Energy: Very Low, Low, Moderate, High. Mood: Very Bad, Bad, Neutral, Good. The coordinate is the identity — never add or multiply the two numbers (E4M1 ≠ E1M4). Cell IDs and band names are never shown on screen.
